podcast.body: The "Godfather of Soul" released this LP during the disco era. It garnered some Black radio airplay but ultimately "disappeared relatively quickly," indicating a less successful adaptation to disco compared to other artists. "Godfather of Soul James Brown released an LP, which was recently titled The Original Disco Man, which scored some Black radio airplay but disappeared relatively quickly."
